description.value: Masa Yama is Smithers' authentic Japanese cuisine restaurant, serving an extensive menu of sushi rolls, sashimi, nigiri, tempura, ramen, udon, and hot entrees in a casual dine-in setting. The kitchen also accommodates takeout orders by phone and offers catering, making it a flexible stop for cyclists in the Bulkley Valley. Vegetarian diners have a solid selection including tofu rolls, veggie tempura, and avocado-based combinations.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at masa-yama.yolasite.com loaded successfully and clearly identifies the business as Masa Yama in Smithers, BC, providing the address (1080 Main Street, Smithers) and phone (250-847-8060) absent from OSM tags. The menu confirms takeout service ('order take out with a simple phone call') and multiple vegetarian options (tofu rolls, veggie tempura, avocado/cucumber/sweet potato rolls, Teriyaki Tofu Box). No evidence for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging amenities appears anywhere in the OSM tags or website content.
concerns: OSM tags contain no address or phone; both were sourced from the website only.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate sit-down and takeout Japanese restaurant on Main Street in Smithers — a key stop on several northern BC cycling routes — with a diverse menu well-suited to touring cyclists including vegetarians.
